title: Sources and origin of data
html:
Viewed 2026-10-30.

  • Galbraith, Ruprai, An Improvement to the Gaudry-Schost Algorithm for Multidimensional Discrete Logarithm Problems, 2009, page 1–3: definition multidimensional DLP as products of intervals, memory BSGS, distinction interval-kangaroo, This is a heuristic nature of multidimensional walks, used for limits of applicability, not as evidence of the complexity of arbitrary walks XOR-projections.
  • Menezes, van Oorschot, Vanstone, Handbook of Applied Cryptography, Chapter 3, §3.6.2: basic BSGS. The control implementation is adapted to additive public points and known intervals.
  • Galbraith, Pollard, Ruprai, Computing Discrete Logarithms in an Interval: bibliographic reference; direct discovery PDF in this session, returned 403. No new variants from unavailable text are used; simple text is selected capped kangaroo, It's not a promise of the best published constant.

Local primary data are listed with SHA-256 into results/INPUTS.json. Complete E5-The catalogue is used as a historical image, without repeated network survey of addresses E5; into E1g The exact equations of the main goals are further verified by the stored certificates.

New public_solver.py uses an elementary wrapping of the addition of public points on a model E1f public_solver.py; file E1f It doesn't change, and its experiments don't restart interval-DLP and explicit conversion of a fixed minor word, rather than the former inter-key XOR-The math of breaking down non-overlapping output support and evaluating story integration is derived here and verified with stored code.
